name: L'viv – the Ensemble of the Historic Centre
description: Lviv's historic centre, in western Ukraine, grew from a late medieval trading town into a busy crossroads of commerce and faith. Its old street layout survives almost untouched, with cobbled lanes, a central market square and Baroque churches and townhouses standing side by side. Separate quarters recall the Ukrainian, Polish, Armenian and Jewish communities who once lived here. The site is currently on the List of World Heritage in Danger.
